papers.title_en: SP-HLM: Sparse-Pose-Driven Motion Generation and Whole-Body Control for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.authors: Zhaohui Yang, Quanbao Lin, Chengqi Shi, Zhenglang Weng, Jicheng Lin, Boyu Chen, Tengjie Zhu, Guanzhu Ren, Jiahao Xu, Yang Feng, Xiaokang Yang, Yao Mu
papers.evidence: 面向人形移动操作的稀疏姿态驱动动作生成
papers.tldr: 人形机器人移动操作需要连接高层任务意图与全身控制的接口，但单一动作表示易加重高层策略负担或使协调约束不足。SP-HLM以稀疏姿态为接口，结合五个关键身体姿态和学习潜在运动先验：SP-VLA预测稀疏姿态与手指关节，SP-MGM实时重建全身动作，SP-GMT融合显式目标与隐式先验进行全身控制。仿真和真机实验表明其运动跟踪、全身协调与移动操作成功率优于现有方法。该框架实现了任务意图与全身协调的互补表示。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires an effective interface between high-level task policies and whole-body control. Existing interfaces typically rely on a single action representation for both task intent and whole-body coordination. This may burden the high-level policy or leave one aspect underspecified. We present SP-HLM, a framework built on a sparse-pose-driven interface. The interface combines five task-critical body poses with a learned latent motion prior to represent spatial intent and whole-body coordination in complementary forms. SP-VLA, a vision-language-action model, first predicts task-relevant sparse poses and finger joint positions from multimodal observations and language instructions using asynchronous action-chunk inference. Given these sparse targets, SP-MGM, a motion generation model trained through two-stage distillation, reconstructs coordinated full-body motion in real time. A pretrained motion encoder maps this motion to a compact latent representation. SP-GMT, a general motion tracker, then integrates the explicit sparse targets with this implicit motion prior for whole-body control. Experiments in simulation and on a real humanoid robot demonstrate improved motion tracking, whole-body coordination, and loco-manipulation success over existing approaches. Additional results and videos are available on our \href{https://sp-hlm.github.io/}{\textcolor{blue}{project page}}.

papers.title_en: Information-Theoretic Scaling Laws for Generative Diffusion Training
papers.authors: Druv Pai, Dejan Stancevic, Yi Ma, Luca Ambrogioni
papers.evidence: 生成式扩散训练的信息论缩放规律
papers.tldr: 扩散模型在有限数据上训练时，输出会依赖具体训练集，表现为记忆与样本质量变化。本文用可计算的“模型信息”度量这种依赖，并考察模型规模与数据规模变化下的缩放行为。作者发现从纯记忆向不完全泛化过渡的非线性区间，以及模型信息线性增长、泛化和样本质量逐步提升的泛化区间。进一步提出信息论启发的缩放律，并推导出记忆与样本质量的诱导缩放律，且在拟合域外具有良好外推。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models trained on increasingly large datasets sampled from the same data distribution will converge to the same learned distribution. However, in practice, a model trained on finite data depends on the particular training dataset; this dependence is reflected in properties of the model's outputs, such as memorization and sample quality. To understand this dependence through an information-theoretic lens, we study \textit{model information}, a computationally tractable measure of how much samples from the trained model depend on the particular training dataset. We explore its scaling behavior as model size and training dataset size vary. Specifically, we uncover two qualitatively distinct scaling regimes: (1) a nonlinear model information regime marking the transition from pure memorization to imperfect generalization, and (2) a generalization regime characterized by linear scaling of the model information and progressively improved generalization and sample quality. We then posit an information-theoretically principled scaling law to quantify these two regimes, and show that this law yields induced scaling laws for memorization and sample quality. We finally demonstrate that these induced scaling laws extrapolate well outside the fit's domain. Our results demonstrate information-theoretic principles for memorization and sample quality scaling laws in diffusion models. Our code is publicly available on \href{https://github.com/DruvPai/diffusion_info_theory_scaling_law}{GitHub}.

papers.title_en: Semantic-First: Temporal Scheduling in Flow Matching for Reliable Emotional Image Generation
papers.evidence: 流匹配模型中的时间调度用于图像生成
papers.tldr: 情感可控图像生成需在改变氛围时保持提示语义，本文把去噪时间作为控制维度。方法在流匹配强化学习中采用语义优先调度：高噪声段用确定性ODE采样，仅在后期窗口进行SDE探索与GRPO更新。在FLUX.1-dev上提升提示忠实度和情感准确率，语义审计主体漂移2.7%，GRPO训练时间较全路径Flow-GRPO减少41.1%。窗口实验揭示情感—语义与计算权衡，并在SD3.5-Medium复现，表明后期探索与更新可兼顾可靠情感生成与效率。
papers.abstract_en: Affect-controlled image generation should change how a scene feels while preserving what the prompt specifies. We study the temporal allocation of stochastic exploration and policy optimization in flow-matching models as a means of controlling this balance. During RL training, our semantic-first schedule uses deterministic ordinary differential equation (ODE) sampling during the high-noise phase and confines stochastic differential equation (SDE) exploration and group relative policy optimization (GRPO) to a late window. Controlled experiments separate exploration location, optimization location, and terminal-step sampling, showing distinct semantic benefits from late exploration and late updates. On FLUX.1-dev, semantic-first improves prompt faithfulness, independently evaluated affect accuracy, and human-rated semantic preservation and overall preference. The expanded semantic audit records 2.7% subject drift, while GRPO training time decreases by 41.1% relative to original full-path Flow-GRPO. Window-width experiments characterize the affect-semantic and computational trade-offs, and replication on SD3.5-Medium reproduces the scheduling advantage. These results establish denoising time as a practical control dimension for reliable emotional image generation.

papers.title_en: Generative Structure from Motion with Native 3D Diffusion
papers.authors: Haobin Duan, Binbin Huang, Mochu Xiang, Yiqun Zhao, Zibo Zhao, Yi Ma, Shenghua Gao
papers.evidence: 用原生三维扩散模型联合去噪形状与相机以生成三维结构
papers.tldr: 针对少量未标定视图下三维结构与相机运动联合恢复问题，传统SfM无法补全未观测区域，原生3D生成又未必忠实输入。GenSfM将图像重建与原生3D扩散结合，用多模态扩散Transformer在共享自注意力中联合去噪形状潜变量与逐视图位姿潜变量。在Toys4k和GSO上，4视图时新视角PSNR提升3.2–4.5 dB、中位Chamfer距离降低2.8–3.8倍，并以超96% Acc@5°恢复位姿。该工作无需外部位姿骨干、后处理优化或已知内参，实现生成先验与观测约束的一致融合。
papers.abstract_en: Recovering an object's 3D structure and camera motion from a few uncalibrated views is a fundamental problem in computer vision. Classical structure from motion methods recover 3D geometry consistent with the input images but cannot recover unseen regions; native generation methods produce plausible 3D objects which are related but not necessarily faithful to the input images. Methods simply concatenating reconstruction and generation allow error to cascade across the two stages, instead of producing a 3D object consistent with both the distribution and the input. We propose GenSfM, which integrates image-based 3D reconstruction with a native 3D diffusion model. In particular, we use a multi-modal diffusion transformer to jointly denoise the shape latent and per-view pose latents under shared self-attention, grounding generated geometry in the observed views while using object-level priors to infer unobserved regions. A compact 3D-native UV-volume tokenization keeps the joint sequence small as views are added, and a pose-aware stage refines geometry and texture by sampling per-voxel image features at the recovered camera poses. On Toys4k and GSO, for $4$ uncalibrated views, GenSfM improves novel-view PSNR by $3.2$-$4.5$ dB and reduces median Chamfer distance by $2.8$-$3.8\times$ over a strong native-3D generation baseline, while recovering input-view poses over $96\%$ Acc@$5^\circ$ without any external pose-estimation backbone, post-hoc optimization, or known intrinsics. Project page: https://dotb1ue.github.io/GenSfm/.

papers.title_en: TOPS: Reshaping Flow Source and Transport for Multi-Task Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Tuo An, Chuhao Zhou, Jiahua Dong, Jingliang Li, Jiaqi Bai, Jindou Jia, Jianfei Yang
papers.evidence: 面向任务的流源先验与传输调度用于流匹配策略
papers.tldr: 多任务机器人操作中，流式策略通常共享单一高斯源先验与固定线性传输路径，难以适配不同任务的运动需求。TOPS在不改网络结构的前提下，利用反向映射的专家动作构建多模态任务源，并依据源目标协方差失配为每个任务调整插值调度。在LIBERO等基准上，它提升分布内、扰动和跨环境表现，单步推理将LIBERO-10成功率从53.44%提高到69.67%，推理时间约为基线六分之一。该方法为语言条件多任务操作提供了更高效的任务自适应流策略。
papers.abstract_en: Flow-based policies for language-conditioned multi-task manipulation commonly share a single $\textit{Gaussian}$ source prior and a common linear transport path across tasks. However, reliably executing multiple tasks with distinct motion requirements remains challenging for a shared policy. We introduce $\textbf{TOPS}$ ($\textbf{T}$ask-$\textbf{O}$riented $\textbf{P}$riors and $\textbf{S}$chedules), which adapts the flow source prior and interpolation schedule to each task without modifying the network architecture. TOPS first constructs multimodal task sources from reverse-mapped expert action sequences, allowing language instructions to select where generation begins. Guided by source-target covariance mismatch, it then slows the transition toward expert actions early in denoising and accelerates it later along directions requiring expansion. Under a $\textit{Gaussian}$ endpoint model, our analysis shows that this schedule adjustment can lower an upper bound on velocity-prediction risk. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and CALVIN demonstrate improved performance across in-distribution, perturbation and cross-environment settings, alongside better data efficiency. Using one integration step, TOPS raises LIBERO-10 success from $53.44\%$ to $69.67\%$ compared with ten-step Standard Flow Matching (FM), while reducing inference time to approximately one-sixth of the baseline. TOPS also yields consistent gains when transferred to the large-scale flow-based $π_{0.5}$ policy across all four evaluated settings. Real-world experiments further demonstrate improved task success, including an increase from $20\%$ with standard FM to $80\%$ with TOPS on the upper-drawer opening task.
